verdict.line: You lose if you throw R (Noxian Guillotine) straight into an up W (Riposte) and eat a parry; you win if you bait that parry with E (Apprehend) first and crash the wave to force a bad fight at 6.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by whether Fiora's W (Riposte) is up or down when you commit. Darius holds both the lane-trade edge and the solo-kill edge here (51.9% win rate over 489 games) because Apprehend can bait out her only defensive tool before your ultimate goes through clean. Left unanswered, though, her (P) Duelist's Dance vitals let her outheal and out-scale extended fights into the mid-late game, which is why the overall shape reads as even instead of a stomp.

theirWindow.what: Do not throw E (Apprehend) or R (Noxian Guillotine) into her here — either bait it with a throwaway Q (Decimate) edge-tick or wait, since a landed parry negates your CC and hits back with a slow that unwinds your whole engage.

yourWindow.when: she's just used or missed W (Riposte)
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window: land E to pull her in, stack Hemorrhage with Q and autos, and execute with R without fear of a parry, per OP.GG's own E-R sequencing note for this matchup.

start.why: The 75.3%-pick, 52% win rate start on this patch; the extra AD and sustain let you win the level 1-3 auto trades she uses to find her first vital procs.

boots.why: 84.6% pick, 53.5% win rate; the flat physical damage reduction blunts both her auto-attack pokes and the counter-damage from a landed W (Riposte) parry.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap on her Lunge (Q) resets so she can't kite out after tagging a vital — first item in the highest-win-rate path (56.9% over 51 games).
Stacking move speed plus the slow-on-hit keeps you attached through extended trades and punishes her attempts to disengage post-vital.
Converts burst into a damage-over-time you can heal through, directly countering the true-damage-and-heal loop from her (P) vitals in late trades.

situational.when: she itemizes to burst you down in a single all-in past level 6 (78.6% win rate in this build path)
her stacked vital procs are outhealing your damage in extended fights
her team stacks magic damage to zone you out of the Fiora lane fight
she starts splitpushing and you need waveclear plus a slow to catch her

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest measured win rate page for this matchup (52.4% over the sampled games); stacking adaptive force and heal off Q, E pulls, and R lets you outlast her vital-proc sustain in the extended trades this matchup forces.

summoners.why: The 59.1%-pick, 53.1%-win-rate combo on this patch; Ghost is what lets you stick through her Lunge dashes since Darius has no dash of his own, and Flash covers the E-R kill combo or a bad-parry escape. Flash+Ignite (49.8%) is the alternative if you're confident you win every early trade outright.

playing.title: Bait Riposte with E first
playing.detail: Never open with R. Throw E (Apprehend) first — if it's parried, her W is now down and your next R goes through clean; if it lands, you're already ahead on the trade.

playing.title: Track her passive vitals
playing.detail: Fiora's (P) marks up to four vitals; once she's hit two or more, expect a free heal and speed burst on her next connected auto, so disengage rather than face-tank the next exchange.

playing.title: Point W at level 1
playing.detail: Take W (Crippling Strike) first for safer short trades, then follow standard E-max priority; its bonus execute damage punishes her sustained-trade pattern without risking a dodged Q.

playing.title: Crash the wave for a level 6 kill
playing.detail: With both lane and solo-kill advantage measured on this patch, shove in around level 5 so you hit 6 first and force her into a fight she can't fully answer with a fresh W.

playing.title: Time engages to Ghostblade's active
playing.detail: Once Youmuu's Ghostblade is up, pop it before engaging or right as she uses Lunge (Q) to disengage, matching her mobility so a tagged vital doesn't let her reset.

playing.title: Respect a fresh parry after a whiffed combo
playing.detail: If your E-R bait sequence misses its window, back off instead of continuing to auto-trade — a reset W punishes prolonged exchanges far harder than a single missed cooldown.

playing.title: Itemize anti-heal once she snowballs
playing.detail: If her vital procs start outhealing your damage output in the mid game, prioritize Bramble Vest over the third core item to close the sustain gap.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-timing and combo reasoning (E-baiting Riposte, vital tracking, power spikes) is my own tactical read layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Fiora’s (P) when fighting her. Do not let her block your ultimate with her (W) by using [E] - [R] combo instead.
